title: A plan before surprises
subtitle: Sam meets Literate AI · onboarding audition

turns.speaker: sam
turns.text: I have a working repository. Please tell me onboarding doesn't mean rewriting it.

turns.speaker: litai
turns.text: It doesn't. Start with doctor, then ask for an adopt plan. Your source stays yours.

turns.speaker: sam
turns.text: And when I run that command, what changes?

turns.speaker: litai
turns.text: The plan is read-only. Review the files and the recorded checks. Applying it is a separate, acknowledged step.

turns.speaker: sam
turns.text: Good. And a green plan means the project's ready to ship?

turns.speaker: litai
turns.text: No. It means we're ready to discuss the next step. Builds, tests, and independent acceptance still have to earn their evidence.

turns.speaker: sam
turns.text: A plan before surprises. I can work with that.

limitations: An audition, not the complete installation and onboarding course.
Illustrated commands are walkthroughs unless linked to a retained real capture.
Silent animatic timing is authored, not measured speech; recorded audio replaces it before narration acceptance.
No onboarding apply, generated-code execution, release, or publication is performed by the renderer.
